 Dakota News Now 2026 First Alert Winter Weather Special 
 Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 8:18 AM CST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Winter is coming. The First Alert Weather Team is highlighting some of the things to keep in mind to ease some of those holiday-season headaches. News
 Search warrant finds stolen guns, tools, trailers and pheasants on Turner County property 
 Updated : 2 hours ago A joint stolen property investigation by the Turner and Hutchinson County Sheriff’s Departments led to the recovery of multiple stolen items at a property in Turner County. News
 Travelers at Sioux Falls Regional Airport share reactions to nationwide ground stop 
 Updated : 2 hours ago The FAA lifted the ground stop just before 8:00 p.m. on Friday and said flights can resume. Travelers in Sioux Falls shared their thoughts while waiting for their flights. News
 Two people dead after Friday afternoon house fire in NW Iowa 
 Updated : 13 hours ago News
 Investigators detail Lake Benton, Minnesota firefighter’s arson confession 
 Updated : 17 hours ago On Thursday, an arrest was made in Lincoln County, Minnesota. Jameson John Vermaat is facing felony arson and property damage charges. Community
 A permanent tribute honoring the late Chief Deputy Ken Prorok 
 Updated : 17 hours ago Dozens of people gathered at the Moody County Courthouse to remember Chief Deputy Ken Prorok, who was killed on duty in February 2024, and to see a memorial chair built in his honor. News
 Glory House appoints Matt Althoff as new CEO 
 Updated : 17 hours ago Althoff most recently served as cabinet secretary for South Dakota’s Department of Social Services, overseeing programs that support children, families and individuals statewide.
